scripts.e2e:backend: cd ../backend && WIKIPULSE_SOURCE=replay WIKIPULSE_REPLAY_SPEED=0 WIKIPULSE_REPLAY_LOOP=false WIKIPULSE_AI=off WIKIPULSE_PULSE_INTERVAL=1 WIKIPULSE_AUTH_USERNAME=e2e WIKIPULSE_AUTH_PASSWORD=e2e-password WIKIPULSE_SESSION_SECRET=e2e-only-secret .venv/bin/uvicorn --factory app.main:create_app --port 8001
scripts.e2e: start-server-and-test e2e:backend http-get://localhost:8001/api/health e2e:frontend http-get://localhost:5174 'env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE cypress run'
scripts.e2e:open: start-server-and-test e2e:backend http-get://localhost:8001/api/health e2e:frontend http-get://localhost:5174 'env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE cypress open --e2e'
